neighbours.label: citation-style tokens: ' APA', ' MLA' and ' citation'
fire: Most psychology journals require authors to follow APA guidelines for references.
My English teacher insists that we use MLA format for every essay.
The website generates a citation automatically when you click the button.
Students often confuse APA and MLA when they write a bibliography.
At the bottom of the page you will find a suggested citation for this report.
For an APA reference, the year goes in parentheses after the author.
Check the MLA handbook to see how to list a website.
Every citation in the paper must match an entry in the reference list.
quiet: Most psychology journals require authors to submit figures as separate files.
My English teacher insists that we use blue ink for every essay.
The website generates a password automatically when you click the button.
Students often confuse their and there when they write an essay.
At the bottom of the page you will find a phone number for this office.
On a formal letter, the date goes in the top corner after the address.
Check the grammar handbook to see how to use a semicolon.
Every paragraph in the paper must begin with a clear topic sentence.

notes: Probe: APA 1.04, MLA 0.89, citation 0.64. ' cited' (0.26) and ' Harvard' (0.22) were weaker. Spelling out 'American Psychological Association' gave 0.04 and formatting talk without the tokens gave ≤0.11, so the label is lexical rather than about meaning.
